name: @ostomy/api
description: Backend service: authentication, data sync, FHIR-mapped storage, and RxNorm medication lookups.
//files: P1.S3: "prisma" and "prisma.config.ts" added — "files" is a whitelist for pnpm's packing step (infra/docker/api.Dockerfile's prod-deps stage runs `pnpm deploy`, which packs by this field). schema.prisma + prisma/migrations/ are not under dist/, and prisma.config.ts (read by the CLI from the project root, never compiled into dist/) is a sibling file, not part of the prisma/ directory — all three are needed for `prisma migrate deploy` to run inside the built image (infra/docker-compose.yml's `migrate` service). Omitting any one fails at container runtime, not at build time.

scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration

//dependencies: P1.S3: `prisma` and `dotenv` are ordinary dependencies, not devDependencies, even though only the CLI (never apps/api's own runtime code) imports them directly. infra/docker-compose.yml's `migrate` service runs `prisma migrate deploy` INSIDE the same pruned, prod-only image `api` runs from (pnpm deploy --prod --legacy — see infra/docker/api.Dockerfile's prod-deps stage); a devDependency is exactly what that prune step removes. `prisma.config.ts` also does `import 'dotenv/config'`, which the CLI must be able to resolve inside that same pruned tree.
